clues: This small town sits inland in Catalonia, Spain. It stands at the very start of a small river.
The streams here run dry most of the time. Yet one wet spell can fill them fast and jam the tight streets.
This place first pops up in old writing in the year 963. That makes its past more than a thousand years long.
A brand new bridge stands ready here, yet no one can use it. The work around it stopped, so it still sits shut.
Two streams join here to form the Argentona Riera. That same pair of streams shows up on the town shield.
